title: Notion Blocks — editor primitive bundle
description: One install ships four notion-style block primitives — KaTeX equation, highlight.js code block, per-page subscription bell, and drag-fill grid cell selection. Each is config-driven (no shared state coupling) so it drops into any React surface: marketing landing, admin panel, full app editor, doc page. Bundled because small primitives are noisier when split four ways in the catalog. Lifted from notion-page-clone (Nosion) via rr-sync.
